description: 한국원자력안전기술원_원자력발전소 안전성능 지표 DB [electricity and power and nuclear facilities] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국원자력안전기술원. 국내 상업용 원자력발전소의 안전운영(비계획 원자로정지, 비계획 출력변동, 복잡한 비계획 원자로정지), 안전계통 신뢰도(안전주입계통, 비상발전기계통, 보조급수계통, 잔열제거계통, 냉각수계통. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국원자력안전기술원. Its tags are 안전성능, 원자력발전소, 원전성능지표, 안전운영, 안전계통신뢰도. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-06-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
